Subject: Renewal & Roadmap — compressed runbook demo + stakeholder handoff

Hi Elaine,

Thanks again for the productive check-in last week. As we discussed in the renewal plan, we'd like to schedule a condensed roadmap + runbook demo for your execs and platform team ahead of the renewal signature. The goal: 45-minute live walkthrough (20m roadmap, 20m demo of the runbook/playbook with a short ops Q&A), then follow-up materials.

Quick asks so we can lock a slot:
- Confirm the preferred week (Nov 16–20 or Nov 30–Dec 4)
- Who needs the recording and who needs a live Q&A (execs vs. platform leads)?
- Any procurement pre-reqs we should coordinate (PO, legal contact, or preferred DocuSign workflow)?

Proposed times (PST) — pick one or propose alternatives:
- Tue Nov 17, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Nov 18, 14:00–14:45
- Thu Dec 2, 09:30–10:15

Attaching a short runbook draft (QBR-runbook-v2.pdf) and an internal checklist for procurement items. If you confirm week and attendee list, we’ll send a calendar invite with a short pre-read.

Thanks — I’ll hold a couple tentative slots until I hear back.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0183
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR-runbook-v2.pdf (18KB), Clearline-procurement-questions.docx (12KB)

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@clearlinehealth.com>

Cc: procurement@clearlinehealth.com
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & Roadmap — compressed runbook demo + stakeholder handoff

Hi Jasmine — thanks for the options. The Nov 17 window conflicts with an internal board prep; Dec 2 looks promising but a bit tight for some folks. Could we do Mon Nov 16 13:00–13:45 PT instead? That would let our platform lead (Samir) join live and record for execs.

Two quick notes: procurement would like your updated quote/term summary before we lock the calendar (I copied them). Also, our policy requires we confirm whether recordings will be stored off-network. Execs want the recording circulated; platform team prefers no cloud retention without a signed DPA addendum.

If you can loop in legal/procurement or confirm the storage approach, we can lock Nov 16.

—Elaine
